summary: Frontend code review of Clinical Documents module for Casesheets, Treatment Sheets, and Extensions. All 10 features verified as CORRECTLY IMPLEMENTED in code. UI testing blocked by known Expo Router web navigation issue that causes session loss on page reload.

ui_bugs.issue: Session/auth tokens lost on URL navigation - full page reload re-initializes React app, ProtectedRoute check runs before auth bootstrap completes, causing redirect to login

integration_issues.issue: Cannot navigate to Clients/Casesheets pages via web - session lost immediately. Login works but subsequent navigation fails.

feature_1_header_branding.details: renderBrandingHeader() checks casesheet?.header_snapshot, renders logo_url, clinic_name, tagline, address, phone. Has testID='branding-header'

feature_2_footer_branding.details: renderBrandingFooter() checks casesheet?.footer_snapshot, renders legal_text, registration_no, website. Has testID='branding-footer'

feature_3_create_treatment_sheet_modal.details: Create Treatment Sheet button (testID='create-treatment-sheet-btn') opens modal via setShowCreateTSModal(true). Modal renders with duration picker.

feature_4_duration_selection_options.details: DURATION_OPTIONS array contains [7, 14, 21, 30, 45, 60] days. All 6 options rendered as TouchableOpacity buttons in durationGrid with visual selection state.

feature_5_custom_duration_input.details: TextInput for custom duration with keyboardType='number-pad', maxLength=3, regex filter to allow only numbers. Clears selectedDuration when custom is entered.

feature_6_add_extension_button.details: Add Extension button with testID='add-extension-btn', shows extension-puzzle-outline icon, triggers setShowExtensionPicker(true)

feature_7_extension_templates.details: EXTENSION_TEMPLATES contains 4 templates: 'Vital Signs' (vitals), 'Prakriti Assessment' (prakriti), 'Nadi Pariksha' (nadi_pariksha), 'Custom Notes' (custom). Each with appropriate fields.

feature_8_add_extension_to_form.details: handleAddExtension() finds template by ID, adds to formData.extensions array with template_id, template_name, and empty data object. Closes picker and expands new section.

feature_9_remove_extension.details: handleRemoveExtension() filters extensions by index. Remove button (trash-outline icon) visible when isEditable=true, has accessibilityLabel.

feature_10_editable_extension_fields.details: Extension fields rendered as TextInput with editable={isEditable}, handleExtensionFieldChange() updates form state. testID pattern: 'extension-field-{template_id}-{field_id}'

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Expo Router web session persistence - auth tokens lost on URL navigation. Root cause: ProtectedRoute runs before auth bootstrap completes after page reload
Solution options: (1) await auth bootstrap in ProtectedRoute before render, (2) use client-side SPA navigation, (3) persist session in cookies instead of AsyncStorage for web

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Expo Router Web Navigation Session Loss
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: When navigating to a new URL in Expo Router web, the entire React app re-initializes. During re-init, tokens ARE loaded from AsyncStorage (seen in console: 'Tokens loaded from storage'), but ProtectedRoute's auth check executes BEFORE the async auth bootstrap completes, causing immediate redirect to login.
reproduction_steps: 2. Navigate to any protected route via URL change or Quick Action click
4. ProtectedRoute checks auth state (still initializing) → shows 'Not authenticated'
potential_fixes: Add loading state to ProtectedRoute that waits for auth initialization
Use synchronous token check from localStorage before render
Implement client-side navigation without URL changes
Use cookies for session instead of AsyncStorage on web platform
